name: ScamRead cyber news feed
note: Headlines and summaries are written by AI (Claude) from the original reports. Follow the source links for the full articles.

items.headline: Critical N-able MailAssure Flaw Lets Attackers Reach Internal Systems
items.summary: N-able patched a critical flaw in MailAssure, formerly SpamExperts, that lets an attacker with privileged API access reach internal network services. Customers should update to build 20261121.1943 or later.

items.headline: Hackers Exploit ScreenConnect Flaw to Hijack MSP Technician PCs
items.summary: Attackers are exploiting a patched ScreenConnect client flaw to target managed service provider servers. A guest can push a malicious payload onto connecting technicians' computers.

items.headline: Microsoft Fixes Azure API Management Flaw Exploited to Steal Secrets
items.summary: Norway's National Security Authority says an unknown actor has been searching Azure API Management for access tokens and secrets, affecting several Norwegian businesses. Microsoft has released a fix for the classic flaw.

items.headline: Hackers Keep Running EvilTokens Phishing After Microsoft Takedown
items.summary: Attackers are still using the EvilTokens phishing kit to take over Microsoft 365 accounts despite Microsoft shutting the service down. New phishing hosts kept appearing in October and November after two arrests in London.

items.headline: CISA Adds Four Exploited Flaws in VMware, SAP, Cisco and Apache Products
items.summary: CISA added four vulnerabilities affecting VMware vCenter, SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway, and Apache Roller to its exploited catalog. Federal agencies were given until November 23 to patch them.
